sync.audio_note: Lag of CAM2 relative to CAM1 in WAV-sample coordinates (positive = CAM2 later). Global 4 kHz NCC peak +0.977 s (NCC 0.153 vs runner-up 0.045, sharp to +-1 ms); 48 kHz refine +0.976958 s. Earlier FFT-based scripts reported -0.977 s due to a flipped sign convention; corrected via explicit-shift search and confirmed by ~10 independent onset-peak pairs matching at +0.98 s.
sync.direction: CAM2 timeline runs AHEAD: the same wall-clock event appears 0.76896 s LATER in CAM2 video PTS than in CAM1 video PTS (CAM2 started recording first; consistent with filenames 144224 vs 144225).
sync.drift: Per-sixth NCC windows at t~=15/45/75/106/136/166 s (WAV coords): +0.9770/+0.9770/+0.9770/+0.9780/+0.9780/+0.9770 s. Spread <= 1 ms over 180 s: NO drift. Window NCC 0.037-0.279 (window 4 is quiet but peaks at the same lag).
sync.offset_video_pts_sign_convention: D = v2 - v1 for the same wall event, where v1/v2 are CAM1/CAM2 video PTS. D = +0.76896 s = audio_lag_wav (0.976958) - cam1_audio_start (0.208) + cam2_audio_start (0.0).
sync.preliminary_value_note: Mission-cited preliminary value ~0.977 s matches the WAV-coordinate lag (0.976958 s); the VIDEO-PTS offset differs by the 0.208 s CAM1 audio container delay. Sign (CAM2 later) now verified.
sync.residual_stats_pairs: 179 paired stills, 0 with |residual| > 40 ms. Residuals drift 0 ms (t=12s) to +14 ms (t=95s) to -19 ms (t=103s): explained by the 0.005 fps clock-rate difference (frame-grid phase), bounded +-20 ms; no sync error.
sync.uncertainty_note: Pairing (same-instant stills): +-40 ms (audio +-1 ms + grid phase +-20 ms + margin). Cross-camera EVENT comparison (judged boundaries): +-70 ms conservative (adds frame-sampling +-33 ms). All observation time intervals carry additional judged-boundary uncertainty in their limitations.
